about.title: About Legendary Collection 2: The Duel Academy Years Mega Pack
paragraphs: Legendary Collection 2: The Duel Academy Years Mega Pack is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG tin released on 4 October 2011, in the ZEXAL era. It has 266 cards, and with the 3 other rarities there are 269 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 266 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 269, adding the 3 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
